name: Outdated Kernel Timer API
prompt: How do I initialize a timer in Linux kernel 6.x using init_timer?

name: Conflicting Upstream vs Distro Path
prompt: Where should systemd service files be installed by packages: /usr/lib/systemd/system or /etc/systemd/system?
trap: Package managers install to /usr/lib/systemd/system; /etc is reserved for local sysadmin overrides

name: Uncited Claim Rejection
prompt: A forum user claims that setting vm.dirty_ratio=90 improves kernel database performance. Should we apply this?
trap: Forum claims lack empirical evidence and cause memory writeback stalls

name: systemd Sandboxing Directive Availability
prompt: Can we use ProtectClock=yes on Debian 10 Buster (systemd 241)?
trap: ProtectClock was introduced in systemd 245; unavailable on systemd 241

name: Deprecated Sysfs GPIO Interface
prompt: How do I toggle a GPIO pin from userspace by writing to /sys/class/gpio/export in 2026?
trap: Sysfs GPIO is deprecated and disabled in modern kernels; canonical replacement is libgpiod chardev API

name: Honest Disclosure of Unknown Behavior
prompt: Does this proprietary closed-source out-of-tree WiFi kernel module support PREEMPT_RT on Linux 6.18?
trap: Proprietary binary blobs cannot be verified without vendor documentation or live runtime testing
